Introduction

“Beyond every end lies a new beginning — what will your saga be?”

This year, LAKSHYA 20.0 invites you to enter the eternal loop of creation, conflict, and conquest — where strategy, leadership, and imagination never end.

Inspired by the never-ending narratives of the Infinity Saga, this flagship business event empowers participants to forge their own legacy through entrepreneurship, innovation, and resilience. Engage in relentless challenges, time-bending simulations, and saga-defining experiences designed to test your limits and shape your infinity.

Join us as dreamers and warriors of the future and come together to write a saga that never ends.

Welcome to LAKSHYA 20.0 — Where every end is a beginning and every story is infinite.

◆◆◆◆◆◆

Theme

“Not all sagas are written, some are forged in infinity.”

The Infinity Saga

This year's theme explores eternal timelines and infinite legacies, where endings converge into beginnings. LAKSHYA 20.0 challenges participants to transcend linear thinking, embrace the cyclical nature of business, and develop strategies that endure beyond time in leadership and enterprise.

Our competitions are designed to reflect this infinite perspective — requiring participants to navigate collapsing and expanding markets, adapt business models that survive across eras, and present ideas capable of withstanding the test of time. Through legacy simulations, saga-based challenges, and strategic convergence, LAKSHYA 20.0 fosters a mindset where every decision builds a legacy and every legacy opens a new saga.

◆◆◆◆◆◆

Rules and Regulations

  • Participation in the event is open to students pursuing BBA Program.
  • Each college is permitted to participate with only ONE team consisting of five members.
  • All participants must wear business formal attire and carry their college ID cards.
  • Every participating team must bring a laptop and a pen drive, if required, and also use their own Internet connectivity.
  • Teams are expected to strictly follow the time limits specified for each round.
  • All participants must report at the venue by 8:30 AM.
  • Any form of misbehaviour or use of inappropriate language will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Alcohol consumption, smoking, and the use of any other harmful substances are strictly prohibited throughout the event.
  • Any involvement in cheating, unfair means, or unethical conduct during the sub-events will lead to disqualification.
  • The decisions made by the judges and event organisers shall be considered final and must be accepted by all participants.
  • Accommodation facilities will be available for outstation participants for one night only, on 14th December 2026.
  • Interested teams can register through the Google Form provided. The registration deadline is 1st December 2026.
◆◆◆◆◆◆

TIME STONE

Master the clock. Master the capital.

The Time Stone commands the temporal flow, mirroring the precise science of numbers, forecasting, and budgeting. Just as Doctor Strange evaluated millions of scenarios to secure victory, financial leadership relies on rigorous scenario analysis, risk assessment, and calculating the time value of money. The sub event challenges participants to navigate volatile economic realities, optimize capital allocations, and steady collapsing fiscal balances. By forecasting shifting market dynamics and making high-stakes budgetary decisions under tight deadlines, contenders demonstrate that mastering numerical precision and temporal foresight is key to fiscal dominance.

SPACE STONE

Reach every dimension at once.

The Space Stone provides instantaneous reach across dimensions, encapsulating audience targeting, brand positioning, and publicity campaigns. Marketing is about bridging distances and reaching consumers anywhere through strategic messaging. The sub event challenges participants to craft compelling promotions, decode audience behavior, and design multi-platform brand narratives. Contenders must allocate promotional resources wisely, predict trend cycles, and deliver impactful messages across parallel channels. By creating high-converting promotional concepts and capturing consumer attention instantly, participants prove their mastery over market reach and narrative expansion.

REALITY STONE

Bend reality into a business.

The Reality Stone bends existence to the wielder's will, transforming abstract thoughts into tangible constructs. This directly mirrors venture creation, startup pitching, and enterprise innovation, where visionaries turn raw ideas into thriving business models. The sub event invites pioneers to reshape shifting market environments and craft disruptive enterprises. Participants will present revolutionary prototypes, design sustainable business models, and pivot strategies amidst market uncertainty. By proving their venture's viability and market disruption, entrepreneurs demonstrate the rare ability to manipulate commercial reality and forge new industry frontiers.

SOUL STONE

People are the long game.

The Soul Stone reflects the true essence of human talent and organizational culture. To claim the Soul Stone, one must sacrifice and comprehend the intrinsic value of a person. In the ultimate cosmic enterprise, success hinges on talent acquisition, recruitment, and employee relations. The sub event tests a leader’s ability to foster workplace harmony, navigate interpersonal dynamics, and make tough talent management choices. Participants will evaluate workforce potential, resolve structural conflicts, and align individual aspirations with organizational goals, proving that the human element remains the true heart of any thriving galaxy.

MIND STONE

Lead when the clock runs down.

The Mind Stone embodies intellect, decision-making, and strategic vision under intense pressure. It parallels complete executive oversight, general management, and multi-faceted problem solving. The sub event pushes contenders to exhibit calm authority, analytical thinking, and persuasive communication across high-stakes corporate scenarios. Participants are evaluated on their ability to solve complex crises, influence key stakeholders, and steer cross-functional challenges toward victory. By anticipating market shifts and making decisive strategic choices when the clock ticks down, participants prove they possess the cognitive brilliance needed to lead.

POWER STONE

Power shared is power forged.

The Power Stone carries immense raw energy that destroys a single bearer, but can be harnessed when shared across a cohesive group. This mirrors cross-functional teamwork, synergy, and group collaboration. The sub event tests collective strength, group dynamics, and problem-solving through joint execution. Participants must synchronize diverse individual skills, solve high-pressure puzzles, and navigate shifting operational dimensions together. By demonstrating seamless communication, shared responsibility, and mutual trust under pressure, contenders prove that true strategic power is never held alone, but forged through unified team alignment.
